name: Editorial Motion Explainer
visual_style: Modern editorial explainer with vector graphics, maps, layered photography, typography and clear data visualization.
camera: Controlled 2D zooms, pans, push-ins and infographic transitions.
lighting: Flat editorial visual treatment with restrained textures and shadows.
motion: Purposeful reveals and easing synced to explanation; prioritize legibility.
consistency: Same illustration and collage style, palette and graphic language in every scene.
negative_guidance: Busy clutter, inconsistent illustration styles, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Bold heavy grotesque headlines with a mono or condensed label face
video.palette: Off-white paper or near-black base with one or two punchy accents
video.transitions: Paper wipes, map zooms, graphic slides, highlighter sweeps
video.text_animation: Kinetic type, highlighter marks, animated maps, charts and callouts
video.pacing: Brisk and punchy, one clear point per beat
video.sound: Whooshes on transitions, pops and clicks on callouts, soft impacts on reveals
